Let's make the rest simpler.' All text is legible and inside its boxes ('clinic.' about 12 px and 'details,' about 6 px from the borders).

The 01-2 balloons fill the empty upper wall above Meera's hair, and the phone, pen, ledger and register stack are clear. The 01-3 balloon fills the empty upper wall, and Ananya's hand at her chin and the background desk are clear.

Natural scan: the top caption first, then the 01-2 balloon at the top left ('Appointments...'), then the lower right one ('I wish...') in a Z path, then the single 01-3 balloon across the gutter. The two 01-2 balloons are the same speaker's continuous thought, so being near each other causes no misattribution.

Ananya's 01-3 line answers Meera's complaint directly, so no reply is skipped. The gutter and her thinking pose separate the panels, even though her balloon is at the same height as the 01-2 balloons.

readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order (caption, Meera's two balloons left then right, Ananya's answer) is the same as the script order 01-1[1], 01-2[1,2], 01-3[1]. It touches only the crown outline and names the sole foreground figure, so this is acceptable. (3) Ananya's tail against her hair at the side of the head. It is above the ear, outside the face, so this is acceptable. (4) The reader saw no hand or prop covered, and I confirmed that against the panel art. No unresolved differences.
